subject: [SIEMCo] Tri-party demo: runbook + slot coordination
messages:
From: Michael Byrne <m.byrne@siemco.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: sales@siemco.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:15:00 +0000
Subject: Co-sell demo runbook and slot for SIEMCo + Redwood

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the intro last week — SIEMCo is excited to run a co-sell demo focused on cross-account ingest and alerting for enterprise SOCs. We'd like to lock a tri-party runthrough (SIEMCo + Redwood + CloudOps) to validate the deployment runbook and demo flow.

Proposed windows next week (all CET):
- Tue Nov 16, 14:00-15:00 CET
- Wed Nov 17, 10:00-11:00 CET
- Thu Nov 18, 15:00-16:00 CET

Attached is a draft agenda and an initial runbook (runbook-v1.docx). Can you confirm whether Redwood can host the demo from an EU region and who from your side should be in the runbook as hosts/support?

Also flagging CloudOps (ops@cloudops.example.com) as the SI side ops contact — they may propose a slight time tweak depending on shift coverage.

Thanks,
Michael Byrne
Head of Solutions
SIEMCo

Attachments: siemco-redwood-agenda-draft.pdf, runbook-v1.docx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Byrne <m.byrne@siemco.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Co-sell demo runbook and slot for SIEMCo + Redwood

Michael —

Appreciate the materials. Yes, we can host from eu-west-1 (Frankfurt) and that should keep latency within the demo SLOs. Vanessa (partnerships) and Jonas (solutions) are looped to confirm host/responsibilities.

Quick notes after a skim of the runbook:
- We should trim the demo to 35 minutes + 10 minute Q&A to respect SI shift windows.
- Need a preflight checklist item for service-account access and a short KV cache warmup step — I'll add this to the runbook.

Of the proposed times, Tue Nov 16 at 14:00 CET works for me but pinging ops to confirm host availability. If CloudOps needs a swap, can we also consider Mon Nov 15 16:00 CET as a fallback?

I'll turn around a runbook update by EOD tomorrow and share a finalized agenda link.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Kimberly — thanks for the quick reply. EU region is ideal. CloudOps confirms Tue Nov 16 is tight for their shift — they requested Thu Nov 18 15:00 CET if that still works for Redwood. If not, Dec 1 at 15:00 CET would also be acceptable (gives ops time to prepare).

We'd prefer Thu Nov 18 initially but can take Dec 1 if Redwood has calendar conflicts. Also would you be able to publish the runbook link so our engineering lead can comment directly?

I'll hold Thu Nov 18 15:00 CET tentatively for SIEMCo.

Cheers,
Michael

Jonas / Vanessa —

Michael has tentatively held Thu Nov 18 15:00 CET but also offered Dec 1 15:00 CET as a fallback. Ops has a shift gap on the 18th afternoon; can you confirm whether either of you can host v1 of the demo on Nov 18 at 15:00 CET? If not, let's lock Dec 1 and notify SIEMCo.

Action items:
- Jonas: confirm solution host and who will run the KV/cache warmup (assign engineer).
- Vanessa: finalize the agenda PDF (35m demo + 10m Q&A) and publish the runbook link for SIEMCo comments.

I will update Michael once we have confirmation. Prefer minimal churn — if both dates are available to us, let's prioritize Nov 18 and only move to Dec 1 if ops can't staff it.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Head of Partner GTM
Redwood Inference
